text.L1: A community is a group of people who live in the same place and help each other.
text.L2: It is bigger than one family. Neighbours and helpers are part of it too.

text.L4: Every job matters because people in a community depend on one another.
text.L5: When people share jobs, big work gets done faster and becomes easier.
text.L6: Cleaning drives, tree planting and festivals bring people closer when we do them together.
text.L7: Now choose the cleaning plan that shows people sharing different jobs.
